lastCompletedStory.title: Add Renovate config auto-updating the toolchain pins

openQuestions: All PRD user stories (US-001..US-008) now have passes:true; no non-operator stories remain. This was the last story in the toolchain-parity PRD. The review cycle (prd.review) should now run to a terminal verdict via the sidecar; nothing further to implement unless review produces FIXES_PENDING follow-up stories.

Two out-of-band OPERATOR follow-ups called out at ship time (not implemented in code, per the story's own notes): (1) install the Renovate GitHub App on this repo (public repo, free) so renovate.json actually takes effect; (2) confirm the CI workflow (`ci` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml) is configured as a required branch-protection status check on main, since Renovate automerge only proceeds once required status checks are green and renovate.json intentionally does not set `ignoreTests`.
nextStoryContext: This was the final non-operator story in the PRD (US-001 through US-008 all pass now). No further implementation stories are expected from this PRD unless the review cycle files FIXES_PENDING follow-ups. If a new story arrives later touching renovate.json, remember the negative-oracle gotcha documented in patterns.md: description prose must not contain the literal substring 'ignoreTests' even in a negated explanatory sentence, since the story's oracle greps the whole file byte-for-byte.

officialDocsValidated.lib: renovate (packageRules: matchManagers, matchUpdateTypes, automerge, ignoreTests semantics)
officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed via WebSearch against docs.renovatebot.com that matchManagers/matchUpdateTypes/automerge/enabled are current valid packageRules fields, and that ignoreTests is a real (opt-in) escape hatch that bypasses the default required-status-check gating for automerge. renovate.json intentionally omits ignoreTests, so automerge for all four managers (bun-version, asdf, dockerfile, github-actions) stays gated on the required CI status check, matching the story's acceptance criteria. No code/config change needed as a result of this check.
